meta.range: 2026-09-19 00:00 to 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (data exists from 2026-09-19 10:52 UTC; PostHog was installed that day)
meta.human_filter: sessions with >=1 $pageview, no event with $virt_is_bot = true, entry referrer not localhost:3456 / 127.0.0.1:3456 / *.vercel.app (unless a query says otherwise)
meta.caveat: Test-account cohort 580233 has 0 members, so team traffic is included (about 48 sessions from 4 devices with 10+ sessions each, Q24). Aggregates only.

queries.what: Recordings in the window, and whether any recording includes /thanks (deny-list check)
queries.hogql: SELECT count() AS recordings, countIf(first_url LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%') AS start_on_store, countIf(first_url LIKE '%/thanks%') AS start_on_thanks, countIf(arrayExists(u -> u LIKE '%/thanks%', urls)) AS any_thanks_url, round(avg(dateDiff('second', st, et)), 0) AS avg_duration_s, min(st) AS first_rec, max(st) AS last_rec FROM (SELECT session_id, min(start_time) AS st, max(end_time) AS et, any(first_url) AS first_url, groupUniqArrayArray(all_urls) AS urls FROM session_replay_events WHERE start_time >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND start_time < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY session_id)

queries.what: Recording coverage of human sessions by device and in-app browser (internal not excluded)
queries.hogql: SELECT device, coalesce(in_app,'') AS in_app, count() AS sessions, countIf(sid IN (SELECT session_id FROM session_replay_events WHERE start_time >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND start_time < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00'))) AS with_recording FROM ( SELECT toString(properties.$session_id) AS sid, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, argMin(properties.$webview_app, timestamp) AS in_app, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY sid HAVING is_bot = 0 ) GROUP BY device, in_app ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20

queries.what: Drop-off replays reviewed: selection and what could be seen (aggregate only; session ids kept out of the wiki)
queries.selection: Every human, non-internal session that started the pre-order form and did not pay (8), plus 18 store-page sessions without a form start chosen to cover long and short visits, paid and organic, phone and laptop, 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-10. To find them again: Q6's inner query with HAVING store_pv > 0 AND purchased = 0, ordered by form_started DESC, duration DESC.
queries.tools: query-session-recordings-list (session_ids) for metadata; execute-sql over events by $session_id for the timeline (pageviews with scroll %, clicks with element text and aria-label, dead/rage clicks, exceptions, funnel events). Video frames were NOT viewed: the MCP returns metadata, not video; Replay Vision summaries were not generated (they spend credits and create objects, outside the read-only remit).
